func pointerParameter(value *Record) {}
func nonNilParameter(value %Record) {}

func (value *Record) pointerReceiver() {}
func (value %Record) nonNilReceiver() {}
func inlineModulo() { _ = left % Thing }

func multilineParameter(
	parameter %ParameterRecord,
) {}

func (
	receiver %ReceiverRecord,
) multilineReceiver() {}

func unnamedParameter(%UnnamedRecord) {}
func (%UnnamedReceiver) unnamedReceiver() {}

func composedParameter(first %*OuterRecord, second %%NestedRecord) {}
func (receiver %*ReceiverRecord) composedReceiver() {}
func (receiver %%DeepRecord) doubleReceiver() {}

func signatureModulo(value [(Left %Right)]Record) {}
func bodyModulo() { _ = left %Thing }
func multilineBodyModulo() {
	_ = bodyLeft %BodyThing
